tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Default working surface: panels, lists, editors. Body text sits here.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels and filled secondary controls. Light separates with shadow-raised; dark with a lightness step.

tokens.name: bg-recessed

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs (with border-default and shadow-overlay).

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost and icon buttons.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or item; always with border-selected.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Filled neutral controls: secondary buttons, filter chips, segmented tracks. One step beyond bg-hover so a control stays visible inside a hovered row. Labels on it use text-primary or text-secondary, never text-muted.

tokens.name: bg-control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on bg-control. Labels on it are text-primary.

tokens.name: bg-plate
tokens.usage: Pure white plate in both themes: behind black product lockups on dark grounds, and the knob of switches.

tokens.name: bg-input
tokens.usage: Text fields and selects at rest — a step below the surface in dark so fields read as wells, not cards.

tokens.name: bg-code
tokens.usage: Code and technical blocks.
